enriched_activities.activity: Lying in bed doomscrolling YouTube videos and replying to WhatsApp messages, unable to settle for sleep
enriched_activities.desc: Lying on back in bed. Holds phone above face with both hands. Thumb swipes up on YouTube feed. Taps a video thumbnail. Watches video with phone held in right hand. Turns head to left side. Presses phone screen to pause. Opens WhatsApp app. Taps a chat with a friend. Types a reply with both thumbs. Presses send. Scrolls back to YouTube. Swipes to next short video. Taps like button. Rolls onto right side. Pulls blanket up to chest with left hand. Types another WhatsApp message. Presses send. Taps a notification banner. Scrolls chat list. Presses phone screen to lock. Places phone face-down on pillow next to head. Closes eyes. Reaches for phone again after a few minutes. Unlocks phone with thumb. Resumes scrolling YouTube feed. Taps another video. Watches with phone in left hand. Replies to a second WhatsApp message. Places phone on the bedside table with left hand. Turns onto back. Pulls blanket to chin. Closes eyes.

Lies on back with eyes closed. Head on pillow. Both arms resting on top of the blanket. Turns onto right side. Pulls blanket over shoulder with right hand. Turns onto left side. Left arm tucked under pillow. Rolls onto back. Right arm moves above head. Turns onto stomach briefly. Turns back onto right side. Right hand grips the edge of the blanket. Pulls blanket up over ear. Legs shift position under blanket. Remains still on right side. Left arm remains extended on the mattress. Head shifts position on pillow. Rolls onto back again. Both arms rest along sides. Remains motionless. Eyes remain closed. Body stays under blanket until waking.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up after oversleeping, checking the phone and gathering clothes while waiting for the shared bathroom to become free after Member 3 finishes
enriched_activities.desc: Opens eyes. Lifts head from pillow. Reaches right hand to bedside table. Picks up phone. Presses side button to wake screen. Checks time on lock screen. Unlocks phone with thumb. Opens Gmail app. Scrolls through Monash emails. Swipes notification away. Places phone on bed. Sits up on edge of bed. Swings both legs to floor. Stands up. Walks to wardrobe. Opens wardrobe door with right hand. Takes out a t-shirt and jeans. Places clothes on bed. Opens drawer. Picks up socks with left hand. Places socks on bed. Picks up phone again. Opens bathroom door and looks inside. Steps back into Bedroom 2. Stands near the door holding clothes. Waits for Member 3 to leave the bathroom. Listens for the bathroom door to open.

enriched_activities.activity: Quick rushed shower, brushing teeth and getting dressed for the day (bathroom free after Member 3 finished at 07:55)
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into bathroom carrying clothes. Closes bathroom door with right hand. Hangs clothes on the hook behind the door. Turns on the shower tap with right hand. Pulls shower curtain closed. Steps into the shower. Washes hair with shampoo. Rinses hair under the water. Washes body with soap. Turns off the shower tap with right hand. Pushes the curtain open. Steps out of the shower. Picks up towel from the rail. Dries hair with the towel. Dries body. Hangs towel back on the rail. Picks up toothbrush from the holder. Picks up toothpaste. Squeezes toothpaste onto the toothbrush. Brushes teeth. Fills a cup with water. Rinses mouth. Spits into the sink. Turns on the tap. Rinses the toothbrush. Turns off the tap. Puts the toothbrush back in the holder. Takes clothes from the hook. Pulls on the t-shirt. Pulls on the jeans. Pulls on socks. Picks up dirty clothes. Opens the bathroom door. Walks out.

enriched_activities.activity: Making a quick breakfast of toast and a strong cup of tea with the kettle and toaster, eating together with Member 3 while they have their caffeine-free breakfast
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into the kitchen. Places dirty clothes in the laundry basket. Opens the bread bag on the counter. Takes out two slices of bread. Places them in the toaster. Presses the toaster lever down. Opens the cupboard. Takes out a mug with right hand. Places the mug on the counter. Picks up the kettle. Fills the kettle with water at the tap. Places the kettle on its base. Presses the kettle switch on. Opens the cupboard. Takes out a tea bag. Drops the tea bag into the mug. Opens the refrigerator. Takes out the milk carton. Places it on the counter. Waits by the counter. Watches the toaster. Pushes the toaster lever up when the toast pops. Picks up the toast with fingers. Places toast on a plate. Picks up a knife. Opens the butter container. Spreads butter on the toast. Picks up the kettle. Pours hot water into the mug. Puts the kettle back on its base. Picks up a spoon. Stirs the tea. Picks up the milk carton. Pours milk into the mug. Puts the milk back in the refrigerator. Sits down at the table opposite Member 3. Says "Morning" to Member 3. Picks up a slice of toast. Eats the toast. Lifts the mug. Drinks the tea. Talks with Member 3 about the morning schedule. Picks up the plate. Stands up. Carries the plate and mug to the sink. Places them in the sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Throwing studio materials, laptop and charger into a bag while checking Monash emails on the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into Bedroom 2. Picks up the backpack from the floor. Sets it on the bed. Opens the backpack zipper with both hands. Picks up the laptop from the desk. Slides the laptop into the backpack sleeve. Picks up the charger from the desk. Wraps the cable around the charger with both hands. Places the charger in the front pocket. Zips the front pocket closed. Picks up the sketchbook from the desk. Places the sketchbook in the backpack. Picks up a pencil case. Places it in the backpack. Picks up a rolled design poster from the shelf. Places it in the backpack. Zips the main compartment closed. Picks up the phone from the bed. Unlocks the phone with thumb. Opens the Monash email app. Scrolls through the inbox. Taps an email. Reads the email. Taps reply. Types a short reply with both thumbs. Presses send. Closes the app. Places the phone in the jacket pocket. Picks up the backpack. Puts both arms through the straps. Adjusts the straps with both hands. Picks up the car keys from the desk. Walks to the bedroom door. Opens the door. Steps out. Closes the door with left hand. Walks down the hall towards the front door.

enriched_activities.activity: Driving to Caulfield campus, running late in morning traffic
enriched_activities.desc: Opens the front door. Steps outside. Closes the front door with right hand. Walks to the car. Presses the key fob button to unlock the car. Opens the driver's door with left hand. Sits down in the driver's seat. Swings legs into the footwell. Places backpack on the passenger seat. Pulls the seatbelt across the chest. Clicks the seatbelt buckle. Inserts the key into the ignition. Turns the key. Starts the engine. Presses the brake pedal with right foot. Moves the gear stick to drive. Releases the handbrake. Turns the steering wheel to pull out of the driveway. Presses the accelerator. Drives along the street. Stops at a red traffic light. Presses the brake pedal. Waits. Presses the accelerator when the light turns green. Checks the rear-view mirror. Changes lanes with the indicator. Stops behind a queue of cars in traffic. Taps the steering wheel with right thumb. Presses the accelerator. Turns the steering wheel into the campus car park. Drives along the parking aisle. Stops in a parking bay. Turns the key to switch off the engine. Unclips the seatbelt. Opens the driver's door. Steps out. Picks up the backpack from the passenger seat. Closes the door. Locks the car with the key fob. Walks towards the studio building.

enriched_activities.activity: Attending Master of Design studio class at Monash Caulfield, working on a group design brief
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into the studio room. Greets the tutor with a nod. Walks to a table. Places the backpack on the floor. Pulls out a chair with right hand. Sits down. Opens the backpack. Takes out the laptop. Opens the laptop lid. Presses the power button. Types the login password. Opens the design file. Takes out the sketchbook. Places it on the table. Picks up a pencil. Sketches layout boxes in the sketchbook. Turns to the group member on the left. Speaks to the group about the brief. Points at the screen with right index finger. Turns the laptop screen towards the group. Types notes into the document. Picks up a highlighter. Marks a section of the printed brief. Stands up. Walks to the whiteboard. Picks up a marker. Draws a flow diagram on the whiteboard. Caps the marker. Walks back to the table. Sits down. Opens the group chat on the phone. Types a message. Presses send. Picks up the printed brief pages. Collates them with both hands. Staples the pages. Places them in the backpack. Continues typing on the laptop. Listens to the tutor's instructions. Nods. Takes out a sticky note. Writes a task list in pen. Sticks it to the laptop lid. Saves the file with a keyboard shortcut. Checks the time on the phone.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating a packed lunch on campus and sketching layout ideas in a notebook
enriched_activities.desc: Picks up the backpack. Stands up. Walks out of the studio room. Walks along the corridor. Pushes the door of the campus cafe area open with right hand. Walks to a bench outside. Sits down. Opens the backpack. Takes out the lunch container. Opens the lid of the container. Picks up a fork. Eats the packed lunch. Closes the container lid. Puts the container back in the backpack. Takes out the sketchbook. Picks up a pencil. Draws three layout thumbnails on the page. Adds labels under each thumbnail with the pencil. Erases a line with the eraser. Redraws the line. Turns the page. Sketches a grid structure. Picks up the phone. Opens Instagram. Scrolls through the feed. Closes the app. Places the phone on the bench. Continues sketching. Takes a photo of the sketchbook page with the phone camera. Adds it to the design folder. Closes the sketchbook. Places it in the backpack. Zips the backpack. Stands up. Picks up the backpack. Walks back towards the studio building.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing studio work, printing prototypes and taking part in a design critique
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into the studio. Places the backpack on the table. Sits down. Opens the laptop. Opens the design file. Adjusts the layout on the screen. Presses the save shortcut. Opens the print dialog. Sets the paper size and print quantity. Presses print. Stands up. Walks to the printer room. Waits at the printer. Picks up the printed sheets from the tray. Checks the print quality. Walks back to the table. Places the sheets on the table. Picks up scissors. Cuts along the trim marks. Picks up a glue stick. Glues the prototype sheets together. Folds the prototype along the score lines. Holds the prototype up with both hands. Pins the prototype to the critique wall. Steps back from the wall. Listens as the tutor comments on the work. Nods. Points at the prototype with right hand. Replies to the tutor. Takes out the notebook. Writes the critique notes in pen. Walks back to the table. Sits down. Opens the laptop. Edits the file based on the feedback. Saves the file. Closes the laptop. Picks up the prototype from the wall. Places it in the portfolio case. Zips the case. Packs the laptop into the backpack. Stands up. Pushes the chair under the table. Picks up the backpack. Walks out of the studio.

enriched_activities.activity: Driving home from campus instead of going straight to the cafe, so as to be home for the household dinner
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to the car park. Approaches the car. Presses the key fob to unlock the car. Opens the driver's door. Places the backpack on the passenger seat. Sits in the driver's seat. Closes the door. Pulls the seatbelt across. Clicks the buckle. Inserts the key into the ignition. Turns the key. Presses the brake pedal. Moves the gear stick to drive. Releases the handbrake. Turns the steering wheel to leave the parking bay. Drives along the campus exit road. Presses the accelerator. Stops at a red light. Presses the brake pedal. Presses the accelerator when the light turns green. Checks the rear-view mirror. Signals with the indicator. Changes lanes. Turns the steering wheel onto the home street. Presses the brake pedal. Stops in front of the house. Turns the key to switch off the engine. Unclips the seatbelt. Opens the door. Steps out. Picks up the backpack from the passenger seat. Closes the door. Locks the car with the key fob. Walks to the front door.

enriched_activities.activity: Doing freelance creative work on the computer with the monitor and desk lamp on
enriched_activities.desc: Opens the front door. Steps inside. Closes the door with right hand. Walks to Bedroom 2. Opens the bedroom door. Steps inside. Closes the door. Places the backpack on the bed. Opens the backpack zipper. Takes out the laptop. Places the laptop on the desk. Opens the laptop lid. Presses the power button. Presses the monitor power button. Presses the desk lamp switch on. Pulls out the desk chair with right hand. Sits down. Logs into the laptop. Opens the design software. Opens the client brief file. Reads the brief on the monitor. Moves the mouse with right hand. Adjusts the canvas size. Draws a shape with the mouse. Changes the colour swatch. Types text into the layout. Saves the file. Opens the browser. Opens the client's reference images. Downloads an image. Places the image into the layout. Resizes the image with the mouse. Saves the file again. Opens WhatsApp Web. Types a message to the client with both hands. Presses send. Continues adjusting the layout. Checks the time on the laptop screen. Saves the file. Stands up. Pushes the chair under the desk. Turns off the desk lamp. Walks to the bedroom door.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating dinner together with Member 1 and Member 4
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into the kitchen. Opens the refrigerator. Takes out vegetables and a packet of chicken. Places them on the counter. Closes the refrigerator door. Opens the cupboard. Takes out a chopping board. Places the board on the counter. Picks up a knife. Cuts the vegetables on the board. Opens the cupboard. Takes out a pan. Places the pan on the induction cooker. Presses the induction cooker power button. Pours oil into the pan. Tips the chopped vegetables into the pan with both hands. Picks up a spatula. Stirs the vegetables in the pan. Adds the chicken to the pan. Stirs again with the spatula. Turns to Member 1. Says "Can you set the plates?" Picks up plates from the cupboard. Picks up the rice cooker bowl. Scoops rice onto the plates with a spoon. Turns off the induction cooker with the power button. Carries the pan to the table. Sets the pan on a mat. Pulls out a chair. Sits down. Eats dinner with Member 1 and Member 4. Picks up the glass. Drinks water. Talks with Member 4 about the day. Puts down the chopsticks. Leans back in the chair. Stands up. Picks up the plate. Carries it to the sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and wiping down the shared kitchen counters together with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Stands at the sink. Turns on the tap with right hand. Picks up the sponge. Squeezes dish soap onto the sponge. Picks up a plate with left hand. Scrubs the plate with the sponge. Rinses the plate under the tap. Places the plate in the drying rack. Picks up a glass. Scrubs the glass. Rinses the glass. Places it in the drying rack. Picks up the pan. Scrubs the pan with the sponge. Rinses the pan. Places the pan in the drying rack. Turns off the tap. Picks up a cloth from the hook. Wipes the counter surface with the cloth. Wipes the area around the induction cooker. Wipes the table surface. Says "I'll do the counters" to Member 1. Rinses the cloth under the tap. Wrings the cloth with both hands. Hangs the cloth back on the hook. Picks up the drying rack plates. Dries them with a tea towel. Stacks the plates in the cupboard. Picks up the pan. Places it in the cupboard. Wipes hands on the tea towel. Hangs the tea towel on the oven handle. Turns off the kitchen light. Walks out of the kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Driving to the cafe for the rescheduled evening shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to Bedroom 2. Opens the door. Picks up the work uniform shirt from the chair. Pulls off the t-shirt. Pulls on the uniform shirt. Buttons it with both hands. Picks up the apron from the hook. Folds the apron and places it in a tote bag. Picks up the phone. Places the phone in the bag. Picks up the car keys from the desk. Walks to the front door. Opens the front door. Steps out. Closes the door with right hand. Locks the door with the key. Walks to the car. Presses the key fob to unlock. Opens the driver's door. Sits down. Places the tote bag on the passenger seat. Pulls the seatbelt across. Clicks the buckle. Inserts the key. Turns the key. Presses the brake pedal. Moves the gear stick to drive. Releases the handbrake. Turns the steering wheel out of the driveway. Presses the accelerator. Drives along the street. Stops at a red light. Presses the accelerator. Signals with the indicator. Turns the steering wheel into the cafe side street. Stops in a parking spot. Turns off the engine. Unclips the seatbelt. Picks up the tote bag. Opens the door. Steps out. Locks the car. Walks to the cafe entrance.

enriched_activities.activity: Working the evening shift at the cafe, taking orders, preparing drinks, cleaning the counter and closing up
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into the cafe. Pushes the staff door open with right hand. Walks to the back room. Opens the locker. Takes out the apron. Pulls the apron over the head. Ties the apron strings behind the back. Walks to the counter. Presses the login button on the register. Greets a customer. Taps the order into the register screen. Prints the order ticket. Picks up a cup. Places it under the espresso machine. Presses the grind button. Tamps the coffee grounds with the tamper. Locks the portafilter into the machine. Presses the brew button. Pours milk into a pitcher. Steams the milk with the steam wand. Wipes the steam wand with a cloth. Pours the milk into the cup. Places the cup on the counter. Calls the order number. Wipes the counter with a cloth. Picks up a tray of cups. Restocks the cup stack on the shelf. Opens the refrigerator. Takes out milk cartons. Restocks the milk in the fridge. Takes a customer's order at the counter. Taps the order into the register. Picks up a pastry with tongs. Places it in a paper bag. Hands the bag to the customer. Wipes the display case glass with a cloth. Empties the cash drawer. Counts notes and coins. Records the total in the closing sheet. Presses the register logout button. Turns off the espresso machine. Turns off the grinder. Picks up a mop. Mops the floor area behind the counter. Rinses the mop in the bucket. Puts the mop back in the closet. Wipes down the counter surface. Turns off the counter lights. Unties the apron. Hangs the apron in the locker. Closes the locker. Picks up the tote bag. Walks to the staff door. Sets the alarm code on the keypad. Opens the door. Steps out. Locks the door with the key.

Walks to the car. Presses the key fob to unlock. Opens the driver's door. Sits down. Places the tote bag on the passenger seat. Closes the door. Pulls the seatbelt across the chest. Clicks the buckle. Inserts the key into the ignition. Turns the key. Presses the brake pedal. Moves the gear stick to drive. Releases the handbrake. Turns the steering wheel out of the parking spot. Presses the accelerator. Drives along the street. Stops at a red light. Presses the brake pedal. Presses the accelerator when the light turns green. Checks the rear-view mirror. Signals with the indicator. Turns the steering wheel onto the home street. Slows down. Presses the brake pedal. Stops in front of the house. Turns the key to switch off the engine. Turns off the headlights. Unclips the seatbelt. Opens the door. Steps out. Picks up the tote bag from the passenger seat. Closes the door. Locks the car with the key fob. Walks to the front door. Unlocks the front door with the key. Opens the door. Steps inside. Closes the door. Locks it again.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and brushing teeth before bed (bathroom free after Member 4 finished at 23:00 and before Member 1 starts at 23:30)
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to Bedroom 2. Picks up pyjamas from the bed. Walks to the bathroom door. Opens the bathroom door with right hand. Steps inside. Closes the door. Turns on the tap with right hand. Washes face with both hands. Picks up the face towel. Dries the face. Hangs the towel back on the rail. Picks up the toothbrush from the holder. Picks up the toothpaste. Squeezes toothpaste onto the toothbrush. Brushes teeth. Fills a cup with water. Rinses the mouth. Spits into the sink. Turns off the tap. Rinses the toothbrush under the tap. Turns off the tap. Places the toothbrush back in the holder. Pulls off the uniform shirt. Pulls on the pyjama top. Pulls off the jeans. Pulls on the pyjama trousers. Picks up the uniform clothes. Opens the bathroom door. Steps out. Closes the door behind with left hand.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down on the phone, doomscrolling YouTube and WhatsApp instead of sleeping
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into Bedroom 2. Places the uniform clothes in the laundry basket. Walks to the bed. Pulls back the blanket with right hand. Sits on the edge of the bed. Lifts both legs onto the mattress. Lies down on the back. Pulls the blanket up to the chest. Reaches right hand to the bedside table. Picks up the phone. Presses the side button to wake the screen. Unlocks with thumb. Opens the YouTube app. Swipes up on the feed. Taps a video. Watches the video with the phone held in right hand. Taps the next video. Swipes to the next short. Opens WhatsApp. Taps a group chat. Types a message with both thumbs. Presses send. Switches back to YouTube. Swipes the feed again. Turns onto the left side. Keeps holding the phone in right hand. Taps another video. Scrolls the comments section. Taps the like button. Places the phone face-down on the bedside table. Pulls the blanket over the shoulder. Closes eyes. Reaches for the phone once more. Unlocks the screen. Continues scrolling. Places the phone back on the table. Pulls the blanket up to the chin. Remains lying still with eyes closed.
